en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a large historicist city hall building with a central dome, clock, and ornate façade. In front of the building is a busy square with market stalls and umbrellas, trams, and pedestrians. The scene shows an urban street extending to the left with another church or tower in the distance. The caption at the top left reads in German: "Graz - Rathaus mit Herrengasse."
